author: billmac3
text:
I would also like to point out that if you substitute
days/weeks/months for trades in your spread sheet, you'll realize that
you DON'T need to have 50% profits/month to grow an account very
quickly. If a take 10 trades/month and make 5:1 on only 5 of them,
risking 1%/trade, that's 20%/month which will do the same as you but in
30 months, not 30 trades. Just something for everyone to think about.
Bill

author: bobyv87
text:
IF, wouldn't be much easier for you to get to 1000k with a plan like
that? I tried it and i managed to triple my account in a month. However,
 DD seems a bit high but is not. (i had 10% - one trade lost)

Trades: 1 - risk 2% and get at least 10% (this is much reasonable in my case because i take partial profits)

2 - risk 10% (your profit) and get at least 50%

3 - you can remain with 10% risk until you lose your first trade.(
Imagine you have a few trades in a row and for each of them you win at
least 50%/trade. )If you then lose 10% its just market money and then
you can start again with 2% risk and repeat the process again.

P.S. I was thinking to publish my equity curve on testimonial forum, but
 10% DD it doesn't look good for any newbies. However, i'll try to keep
going until my profit its up to 1000% and then i will start trading for
living. After that i think i can post a nice equity curve. The only
hope is not to be in a situation like USDCHF with a big spike against
me.
